standard_prerequisites.name: Twisted GC structure and twisted GC manifold
standard_prerequisites.statement: An almost GC structure is a GC structure when the corresponding complex Dirac structure is Courant involutive; given a closed three-form H, it is an H-twisted GC structure when the structure is H-twisted Courant involutive, and (M,E,H) is then a twisted GC manifold; retained at source lines 187-193.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the three objects of the hypothesis of the counted theorem, namely the twisted GC manifold (M,E,H) with its associated complex Dirac structure E.

standard_prerequisites.name: Twisted GC submanifold and the induced structure E_S
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a submanifold S of a twisted GC manifold (M,E,H), if E_S is a subbundle of the complexified generalized tangent bundle over S meeting its conjugate trivially, then (S,E_S,j^*H) is a (twisted) GC submanifold of (M,E,H), with J_S the GC structure induced by E_S; retained at source lines 302-304.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the object S of the counted theorem and the structure E_S whose G-stability the proof establishes first.

standard_prerequisites.name: Twisted generalized Hamiltonian action, moment map and moment one-form
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a Lie group G acting canonically on a twisted GC manifold (M,J,H), the action is twisted generalized Hamiltonian when there are a G-equivariant map mu into the dual of the Lie algebra and a G-equivariant one-form alpha with values in that dual such that for every xi one has xi_M = -J(d mu^xi) - alpha^xi, equivalently xi_M + alpha^xi - i d mu^xi a section of E, and iota_{xi_M} H = d alpha^xi; mu and alpha are called a generalized moment map and a moment one-form; retained at source lines 570-588.
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the two defining identities that the proof has to reproduce on S, with mu restricted and alpha pulled back.

core_obligations: Show first that the action of G on S preserves E_S: take x in S and (X,lambda) in the intersection of the complexified tangent space of S plus the complexified cotangent space of M with E_x, so that (X, lambda restricted to S) lies in E_{S,x} (source line 624).

Use the G-stability of S to get that the inclusion j is G-equivariant, hence that its differential is G-equivariant and g_*(X) lies in the tangent space of S at g·x, and compute (g^{-1})^* (lambda restricted to S) = j^* (g^{-1})^* lambda = ((g^{-1})^* lambda) restricted to S (source lines 626-637).
Conclude from the G-stability of E that g·(X + lambda) lies in E_{g·x}, hence g·(X, j^*lambda) lies in E_{S,g·x}, so that E_S is G-stable (source line 638).

Assume (S,E_S,j^*H) is a GC submanifold, so that E_S is a vector bundle meeting its conjugate trivially and is j^*H-twisted Courant involutive, and use the G-equivariance of j to obtain xi_M restricted to S equal to xi_S and the two pullback identities for mu and alpha (source line 641).

Transfer the defining identity of the twisted Hamiltonian action to S: by naturality of the exterior derivative d (j^*mu)^xi = j^*(d mu^xi), so the pointwise membership in E_x of xi_M + alpha^xi - i d mu^xi gives the corresponding membership in E_{S,x} for the restricted data (source lines 641-652).

Verify the second defining identity on S by the chain iota_{xi_S} j^*(H) = j^*(iota_{xi_S} H) = j^*(iota_{xi_M} H) = j^*(d alpha^xi) = d (j^*alpha)^xi, and conclude that the restricted action is twisted Hamiltonian with moment map mu restricted to S and moment one-form alpha restricted to S (source lines 653-665).

proof_roadmap.step: Set up x in S and a generic element (X,lambda) of E_x cut down to the submanifold.
Use the G-equivariance of the inclusion to prove that E_S is G-stable.
Record the three identities that follow from the G-equivariance of j: xi_M restricted equals xi_S, and the pullbacks of mu and alpha.
Move the first defining identity to S using the naturality of the exterior derivative.
Move the second defining identity to S by a chain of pullback identities and conclude.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 SIGMA 6 (2010) 081 的 Theorem thm6（源 617-620 行，证明 623-666 行，共 44 行）：设 G 以 twisted generalized Hamiltonian 方式作用在 twisted GC 流形 (M,E,H) 上（有广义矩映射 mu 与矩一形式 alpha），证明对 G-稳定的 twisted GC 子流形 S，限制作用仍是 twisted Hamiltonian，矩映射为 mu|_S、矩一形式为 j^*alpha。关键操作不是例行核验：先要证明 E_S 被 G 保持——把 E_x 中元素写成 (X,lambda)、用 S 的 G-稳定性推出 j 与 G 作用交换、再逐项算 (g^{-1})^*(lambda|_S)=((g^{-1})^*lambda)|_S（624-638 行）；第二步把两条定义恒等式搬到 S 上：第一条靠外微分的自然性 d(j^*mu)^xi=j^*(d mu^xi) 与逐点属于 E_x 的会员关系（641-652 行），第二条靠五个等号的拉回链 iota_{xi_S}j^*(H)=j^*(iota_{xi_M}H)=j^*(d alpha^xi)=d(j^*alpha)^xi（653-665 行）。难点在于每一步都要区分「在 M 上成立」与「拉回到 S 后成立」两套对象，并且两次用到 j 的 G-等变性；原文位置在证明的 626-638 行与 641-665 行。
